environment: one packaged app process, isolated HOME, disposable project folder
steps: Build the package from the exact pushed issue branch commit with package-release; validate its manifest and run its packaged --help command.
Launch the exact package using an isolated HOME and create a new disposable workspace with a non-empty goal and project directory outside the app data directory.
Open Agent Roles with no CLI profiles registered; the Generate plan button is disabled and the coordinator-not-registered reason is visible.
Leave the packaged UI open on Agent Roles for review.
